nodes.label: Compiled integration contract and Runner
nodes.rationale: Integrations are compiled Go packages with declarative fields and storage-independent pull results. app.Open injects integrations into Runner to avoid a contract-to-implementation import cycle; a process boundary would add no external interoperability.

nodes.label: Declarative integration fields and isolated secret storage
nodes.rationale: Integration JSON lives outside the whole-document general settings to prevent stale saves overwriting skips. Stable server-generated list-row IDs preserve keychain secret identity when labels change; resolved Config keeps implementations away from keychain access.

nodes.label: Google Calendar secret-iCal integration
nodes.rationale: On-demand secret iCal feeds avoid OAuth verification and token-expiry burdens. go-ical and rrule-go handle feeds and recurrence; cached TZID locations avoid repeated disk reads. Errors name calendar labels without leaking secret addresses.

nodes.label: SyncEvents: idempotent event reconciliation and tombstones
nodes.rationale: UID plus original occurrence start preserves identity when meetings move. Keyed soft-deleted rows preserve user removals; pruning clears keys so returning events can reappear. Any failed source disables pruning because deduplicated rows do not retain calendar provenance.
